Alan Bresloff 4 years ago [rating=4]Try to imagine an X Rated Sesame Street! In reality, that is pretty much what "Avenue Q The Musical" is ! Yes, this is a musical comedy that won the "Triple Crown" ( winner of the Tony for "Best Musical", "Best Score" and "Best Book"). It is a story about a college graduate who is ready to conquer the world.
